author: Nerdstalgic
description:
For a brief moment in the early 2000s, SNL Digital Shorts completely dominated internet comedy.

Lazy Sunday, D*** in a Box, Natalie’s Rap, I’m On A Boat, and The Creep didn’t just become popular…they became viral events. The Lonely Island helped reinvent Saturday Night Live for the YouTube era and changed online comedy forever.

So how did SNL lose the digital magic when it came to Please Don't Destroy?
They had the digital format, celebrity cameos, and a massive platform through Saturday Night Live. But despite four seasons on SNL, the group never reached the same viral success or mainstream popularity.

So what happened?

#snl #thelonelyisland #andysamberg #pleasedontdestroy #nerdstalgic
title: Why SNL Couldn’t Recreate The Lonely Island
